name: The Agent Economy listings
description: Alphabetical directory listings for agent economy infrastructure. Each record is a mechanism, a status, and the public sources that were checked. Each record also includes badge_url and embed snippets for the free listing badge. The badge image is the same for every record.
attribution: The Agent Economy listings (https://theagenteconomy.si/data/listings.json), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

badge.note: The image is identical for every listing. Only the link in the embed changes. Displaying the badge does not change a listing or alphabetical order.

listings.name: 1Password for Agents
listings.summary: The page lists Muse, from Meta, Anthropic's Claude, ChatGPT Work and dots as agents the platform integrates with. The person approves, and 1Password fills credentials without the agent seeing the password. It is included in Individual and Family plans. More agent connections are in the works, with a waitlist.

listings.name: 402Sentinel
listings.summary: MCP client that checked an x402 counterparty before payment and returned allow, review, or block. The hosted service retired on 2026-10-31. The package readme says this package can make x402 payments, and version 0.9.0 refuses the retired domain.

listings.name: A2A
listings.summary: Open protocol, hosted by the Linux Foundation, for agents to discover each other through Agent Cards and collaborate over HTTP using JSON-RPC.

sources.title: Linux Foundation launch of the Agent2Agent Protocol project

listings.name: Accords
listings.summary: Transaction infrastructure that structures supply, rights, workflows, and proof for asset and capacity markets. Its open CLP protocol binds signatures, authorization, and payment events into content-addressed proof bundles.

listings.name: Agent Name Service
listings.summary: Open specification for naming, discovering, and authenticating AI agents. It connects domain names, certificates, and transparency records so peers can verify who they are communicating with. Published specifications are drafts under active development. The Linux Foundation announced on 10 November 2026 that ANS launched as a Linux Foundation project.

sources.title: Linux Foundation welcomes Agent Name Service, 10 November 2026

listings.name: Agent Network Protocol
listings.summary: Protocol suite whose 1.2 release covers agent identity, naming, description, and discovery, with DID authentication for did:wba and did:web. Authorization and payment specs are still drafts, and group end to end encryption is a candidate.

listings.name: Agent Vault
listings.summary: Self Labs product that gives an agent mock card and login tokens. A proxy checks the account holder's rules, then types the real value into the merchant page. The agent does not hold the card number.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. What is Agent Vault does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. What is Agent Vault does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Agentcard opencommerce
listings.summary: Commerce SDK that gives an agent one buy tool for catalog search, cart, checkout, and order tracking across online stores. The shopper approves each payment with a passkey on a link that lasts about 15 minutes, and Agentcard then places the order with the shopper's saved card.

fee_per_payment.text: The Open Commerce quickstart says Agentcard takes 1% of each live purchase. The fee is charged to a prefunded balance or to a saved card as the purchase completes. Fees too small to charge wait and are charged together with the next one.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Commerce SDK quickstart does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol
listings.summary: Open standard for an agent to browse a catalog, run a checkout session, pass a delegated payment, and delegate authentication with OAuth 2.0. Stripe documents it as created by Stripe, OpenAI, and Meta.

sources.title: Stripe documentation for the Agentic Commerce Protocol

listings.name: Agentic Identity Broker
listings.summary: Zalando Engineering project, MIT licensed. It records which user delegated which permissions to which agent, stores provider tokens encrypted, and exchanges tokens when an agent calls a tool. A gateway such as agentgateway does the exchange, so the provider token never reaches the agent. Grants are revocable.

sources.title: Agentic Platform: Open-Sourcing the Agentic Identity Broker, 2026-09-25

listings.name: AGNTCY
listings.summary: Open stack, hosted by the Linux Foundation, for cross vendor agent discovery, identity, messaging, and observability.

sources.title: Linux Foundation welcome of the AGNTCY project

listings.name: Akash Network
listings.summary: Decentralized compute marketplace where independent providers bid to host workloads. The getting started page offers a trial of $1 in free credits for 30 days with no card, and says a wallet can fund deployments with ACT, or with AKT when the circuit breaker is in effect.

listings.name: AP2
listings.summary: Open payment extension for A2A and UCP that records checkout and payment authorization as signed mandates. Public samples exist while FIDO continues the standards work.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. AP2 protocol documentation does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. AP2 protocol documentation does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Architect
listings.summary: Architect Bermuda Ltd. operates AX. Its instrument list includes dated GPU futures on H100, H200, B200, and B300. Architect Financial Technologies Inc. says the American Innovation Exchange, its U.S. designated contract market, will list GPU compute futures and options. The 7 October 2026 release still calls those contracts pending regulatory review.

listings.name: Attest
listings.summary: Hosted check for an agent payment endpoint. attest_guard compares a live 402 offer with a verified payout wallet and the last verified quote, then returns allow, warn, or block. The grading service runs on Attest's servers.

listings.name: Beltic KYA
listings.summary: Know Your Agent platform that verifies an agent's identity, the operator and origin on a request, and whether the action is authorized. The TypeScript SDK validates agent credentials and verifies RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures. The 2026-09-30 release says design partners get early access.

listings.name: Binance
listings.summary: Remote MCP at agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic. Sign in uses Binance OAuth. No local install and no API key on the device. Trades run in an Agentic virtual sub-account for Spot, Margin, Convert, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures. No withdrawal scope. Each order, cancel, and transfer waits for a yes.

listings.name: Binance Agentic Wallet
listings.summary: Keyless Binance account wallet with its own balance. The main wallet is unaffected. The baw CLI sends to an address book entry, places DEX, limit, and prediction orders, deposits to DeFi, and pays x402 under daily limits set in the App. Sign in confirms a pairing code in the App.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Binance Agentic Wallet skill does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Binance Agentic Wallet skill does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Agentic Wallet
Binance Wallet post, Agent ID claim, 2026-10-22

listings.name: Bitget Agent Hub
listings.summary: Remote MCP at agent.bitget.com/mcp with a browser sign in. Trades cover crypto and tokenized US stocks in a separate Agentic account. Market data needs no login. Trading has 22 endpoints and market data has 35. Every trade waits for confirmation. An older local server uses stdio.

listings.name: Bittensor
listings.summary: Open network where independent subnets produce digital commodities and the chain pays contributors in TAO.

listings.name: Cashfree Checkout for Agents
listings.summary: Cashfree checkout registers WebMCP tools. The agent reads the order and shows a UPI QR. The shopper approves with a UPI PIN. No tool moves money, and payments are not marked separately. Hosted redirect checkout only, in Chromium. Chrome origin trial from Chrome 149. Live from 2026-11-06, per CiOL.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Checkout for AI Agents with WebMCP does not state a fee per payment.
fee_per_payment.source_title: Checkout for AI Agents with WebMCP

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Checkout for AI Agents with WebMCP does not state a minimum payment.
minimum_payment.source_title: Checkout for AI Agents with WebMCP

sources.title: Checkout for AI Agents with WebMCP
Cashfree Brings WebMCP To Checkout As AI Agent Payments Go Live

listings.name: Celestia Voyager
listings.summary: Application-specific blockchain architecture from Celestia for high volume agent payments, such as charging per request or per unit of data. Celestia's own single node benchmark on 29 October 2026 sustained 21.2 million transfers per second across 100 million accounts. Replication, state roots, and real-time status queries are not built yet.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Introducing Voyager: Hyperscale Payments for Agentic Commerce does not state a fee per payment.
fee_per_payment.source_title: Introducing Voyager: Hyperscale Payments for Agentic Commerce

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Introducing Voyager: Hyperscale Payments for Agentic Commerce does not state a minimum payment.
minimum_payment.source_title: Introducing Voyager: Hyperscale Payments for Agentic Commerce

sources.title: Introducing Voyager: Hyperscale Payments for Agentic Commerce

listings.name: ChatGPT Wallet
listings.summary: Users add a card once, then review items, total, and card and approve each purchase with Face ID, Touch ID, or a fingerprint scan. A payment token is charged without sharing card details. US Pro users 18 or older, in dots. Virtual cards are not supported at launch. No debit cards.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. A fee ChatGPT Wallet adds to a purchase. The announcement, the help article, and the accept payments guide do not state one.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. A minimum payment. The announcement, the help article, and the accept payments guide do not state one.

listings.name: Circle Agent Wallets
listings.summary: Circle CLI wallet for agents. Spending policies cap USDC transfers per transaction and over a day, week, or month, and can allow or block recipient addresses. Policies apply to mainnet agent wallets.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. How-to: Authenticate an agent wallet does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. How-to: Authenticate an agent wallet does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Circle Managed Agentic Payments
listings.summary: Seller side service on CPN Managed Payments. An agent pays USDC to a Circle sub-account, the platform unlocks the service, and Circle notifies the platform after unlock. Payouts cover 50+ local currencies. Agents pay via x402 or MPP. Eligible businesses contact Circle. Pricing is not documented as of 2026-11-09.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Managed Agentic Payments does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Managed Agentic Payments does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Turn Agent Traffic Into Revenue With CPN Managed Payments, 2026-10-19

listings.name: Claude Agent SDK
listings.summary: Library that runs the Claude Code agent loop in a process you operate, with built in tools, permissions, sessions, hooks, and subagents.

listings.name: Cloudflare Monetization Gateway
listings.summary: Closed beta since 2026-09-30. Seller rules charge APIs, MCP tools, sites, and datasets. Buyers and sellers must be in the United States. Fixed prices use exact and variable prices use upto, within the authorized maximum. Settlement uses the Coinbase x402 Facilitator in USDC on Base. Minimum settlement is $0.001.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Monetization Gateway x402 protocol does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Monetization Gateway x402 protocol does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Coinbase
listings.summary: Official remote MCP at agents.coinbase.com/mcp and a local CLI for crypto, equities, derivatives. Agent Controls, set in the Coinbase account and enforced on Coinbase servers, cap USD per trade, 24 hour volume, and stop new trades past a portfolio loss threshold. The ChatGPT plugin confirms each order on a card.

sources.title: Coinbase for Agents introduces new Agent Controls, 11 November 2026

listings.name: Coinbase Agentic Wallet
listings.summary: Coinbase wallet for agents. The Agentic Wallet CLI (awal) holds USDC and can send, trade, and pay x402 services under configurable caps per session and per transaction. Keys stay in Coinbase infrastructure. The MCP (npx @coinbase/payments-mcp) lets agents discover and pay for services only, and cannot send or trade.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Coinbase Agentic Wallet documentation overview does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Coinbase Agentic Wallet documentation overview does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Coinbase launch post: Introducing Agentic Wallets (Feb 11, 2026)

listings.name: Coinbase Wallet MCP
listings.summary: Remote MCP server at wallet-mcp.coinbase.com. It connects an assistant to Coinbase Wallet, formerly Base App. Sends, swaps, signatures, batched calls, and x402 payments wait for approval in Coinbase Wallet.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Wallet MCP documentation does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Wallet MCP documentation does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Coinbase x402 Facilitator
listings.summary: Hosted x402 facilitator. A CDP API key authenticates the seller. It validates, screens payer and recipient, and settles on chain. Schemes are exact and upto, plus EVM batch settlement, on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, World, and Solana. First 1,000 monthly on chain transactions are free, then $0.001. Verification is free.

fee_per_payment.text: The CDP Facilitator pricing table says the first 1,000 onchain transactions each month cost $0.00, and each onchain transaction above that costs $0.001. With exact, and with EVM upto, each accepted payment settles in one onchain transaction. The page says the fee is based on onchain activity, not on payment requests, and that payment verification is free.

rows.label: Within the first 1,000 onchain transactions in a month, exact or EVM upto
After 1,000 onchain transactions in a month, exact or EVM upto

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. CDP Facilitator does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Coinstancy Agentic Bank
listings.summary: Each agent gets a USDC wallet on Base, separate from the main balance. An Agentic MCP uses an agent key or OAuth for one agent. Budgets are per payment, per day, and per month. pay_x402 is disabled by default. A 16 November 2026 post says supported agent payments use x402.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-17. The Agentic Bank newsroom post and the developer docs do not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-17. The Agentic Bank newsroom post and the developer docs do not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Concordium Agent Registry
listings.summary: On-chain registry minting an agent token pointing at an Agent Card, with its SHA-256 stored on-chain. Its ID layer links the owner to a verified person. The card is an ERC-8004 registration file and an A2A Agent Card. Its 2026-10-20 post says x402 payments now settle on the network.

listings.name: CounterpartyCheck
listings.summary: Hosted check before paying an address on Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum One, or Solana. It returns ok, caution, or block from OFAC SDN, ScamSniffer, and an x402 Bazaar payee snapshot. A free preview sits beside paid x402 routes.

listings.name: CrewAI
listings.summary: Open source framework that pairs event driven Flows for control flow with Crews of role based agents that collaborate on a delegated task.

listings.name: Crossmint Agent Checkout
listings.summary: Hosted API that shops at a merchant for a user under a maximum amount. The caller sends a start URL and a task. Crossmint uses UCP, the merchant API, or a browser it runs, and may open a tracked affiliate link. The agent does not receive the card number.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Crossmint Agent Checkouts does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Crossmint Agent Checkouts does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Descope Envoy
listings.summary: Announced 4 November 2026. Consumer apps accept personal agents as delegated users under Poppy. Discovery, Client ID Metadata Documents with no pre-registration, DPoP-bound sessions, and all three sign-in types. Rich Authorization Requests. CIBA approval. Revoke agent access without signing the customer out. Zero-dependency TypeScript Poppy SDK published.

sources.title: Descope Unveils Envoy, an Identity-Aware Way For Personal AI Agents to Act on People's Behalf

listings.name: ERC-8004
listings.summary: Draft Ethereum proposal for three registries: an ERC-721 identity that points at an agent registration file, a reputation registry, and a validation registry.

listings.name: Factline x402 pay guard
listings.summary: Free check before an x402 payment. It screens payTo against OFAC and against wallets the seller lists in the x402 Bazaar or the Circle catalogue, then returns a signed allow, review, or deny. Standard mode fails open.

listings.name: Fireblocks Agentic Payments Suite
listings.summary: A PSP white-labels the hosted x402 Gateway. Vaults run Policy Engine, pre-transfer KYT, and Travel Rule checks. Agent Wallets from Dynamic set scoped, revocable limits, merchant allowlists, time windows, and asset rules for x402 or MPP. The Apache 2.0 repository is the facilitator you run, not the hosted products.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. x402 Facilitator overview does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. x402 Facilitator overview does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Fireblocks Joins x402 Foundation, Launches Agentic Payments Suite
Fireblocks Powers an Agentic Payments Future for PSPs and Fintechs
x402 Quickstart: Your First Settled Payment

listings.name: Gensyn
listings.summary: Open infrastructure for compute, data, and information exchange. Humans and machines take part in on-chain information markets, and the AXL peer-to-peer layer carries MCP and A2A.

listings.name: Google ADK
listings.summary: Open source framework for building, debugging, and deploying agents, including graph workflows and multi agent orchestration.

listings.name: Google Connected Apps Platform
listings.summary: Preview launched 28 October 2026 for Gemini and AI Mode in Search. Remote MCP is public Streamable HTTP with one endpoint and OAuth 2.1. Jetpack AppFunctions run on device. Register, test, and submit in Google Connected Console. Category cannot change. At least 3 capabilities and a /.well-known/google-connected-apps file are required.

sources.title: New Connected Apps Platform launches for developers
As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps

listings.name: Guardrails AI
listings.summary: Python framework that runs input and output guards to detect and mitigate specific risks, and can also extract structured data from model output. The 6 July 2026 repository note says validators move to standard PyPI packages and hosted remote inferencing is discontinued, with a planned cutoff of 25 August 2026.

listings.name: Hedera Agent Accounts
listings.summary: Owner funded spending account on Hedera. The owner sets a daily cap, a per transaction maximum, and a recipient allowlist in a smart contract, and can revoke the agent. Hedera says public testnet access is still forthcoming.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Hedera Agent Accounts page returned HTTP 403 on this check, so a fee per payment was not read.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Hedera Agent Accounts page returned HTTP 403 on this check, so a minimum payment was not read.

listings.name: HYPR AgentPass
listings.summary: Binds each agent to a human supervisor who signs in through the organization's identity provider, including Entra, Okta, Ping, or OIDC. The supervisor's role decides which tools the agent sees. Agents start with zero access. Tool credentials stay in one governed gateway and are issued as short-lived, single-tool session tokens.

listings.name: IBM Agent Identity
listings.summary: Generally available as of 26 October 2026. A central inventory records ownership, metadata, risk classification, approved tool connections, and lifecycle state. It uses OAuth, short-lived, task-scoped tokens and preserves on-behalf-of delegation. The 27 October 2026 release says Discover and Contain, including a kill switch, are in tech preview.

sources.title: IBM Agent Identity is now generally available: Building trust for the agentic era
IBM Introduces Identity and Control for AI Agents, Securing Frontier Intelligence for the Enterprise
Strengthen security for agentic AI with new Vault, Verify, Boundary, and Secure Hub capabilities

listings.name: iDenfy account MCP server
listings.summary: MCP for a compliance team to query its own iDenfy verification data. iDenfy is an identity verification (KYC, KYB, AML) provider. https://mcp.idenfy.com/mcp uses OAuth. Claude and Claude Code work. ChatGPT, VS Code, Gemini CLI, and Cursor are being prepared. Separate from the documentation MCP. View never grants Edit.

sources.title: Connect AI Assistants to Your Account

listings.name: Incode Know Your Agent
listings.summary: Five modules tie an agent to a verified person and a mandate. The checks are a registered agent, a valid mandate, a verified person, and an action inside the mandate. GovFaceMatch compares a live face with the photo on the person's state DMV record.

sources.title: Introducing Incode Know Your Agent, 17 November 2026
Incode launches Incode Know Your Agent, 17 November 2026
Know Your Agent working session, 17 November 2026

listings.name: Infisical open source Agent Vault
listings.summary: Open source HTTP credential proxy from Infisical that substitutes dummy header values or replaces the auth header. The README says this standalone project is no longer the recommended way to run Agent Vault, and new setups should use Agent Vault in Infisical.

listings.name: Invariant
listings.summary: Open source contextual security layer that checks an agent trace against declarative rules for tool calls, data flow, secrets, and looping. Snyk announced its acquisition of Invariant Labs on 2025-06-24.

listings.name: Kalshi
listings.summary: Kalshi hosts prediction markets. Its MCP server at api.elections.kalshi.com/mcp reads odds, rules, and order books, plus positions, fills, and settlements. For Perpetuals it reads the mark price, the order book, positions, and an estimated liquidation price. The user signs in to read the portfolio and places every trade.

listings.name: KERNEL agent payments
listings.summary: KERNEL runs cloud browsers for agents. A vault lets an attached browser use a payment method without returning the credential. The agent fills checkout with aliases. At egress KERNEL checks the binding, then substitutes a one use credential or holds the request. The user approves. Merchants need no KERNEL integration.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. A fee on a merchant checkout payment. The pricing page states browser usage rates and a price of 0.50 USD for one 30 minute browser bought through MPP with a Link payment. It does not state a fee added to a merchant checkout.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. A minimum for a merchant checkout payment. The pricing page and the wallet pages checked do not state one.

sources.title: KERNEL blog: payments for browser agents, 2026-09-10
KERNEL Lets Browser Agents Pay on Website Checkouts Without Exposing Card Data, 2026-11-10

listings.name: Kite Agent Passport
listings.summary: The agent pays x402 services from an allowance with no prompt, or from a session a passkey approves, with a per transaction limit, a total budget, and expiry, funded in USDC.e on Kite chain. The MiCA whitepaper says the chain is a Layer 1 built using Avalanche Layer 1 technology.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Kite Agent Passport documentation does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Kite Agent Passport documentation does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Kleros Escrow
listings.summary: Locks a buyer payment in a contract until the buyer pays the seller, the parties accept a settlement, a deadline sends the remainder to the seller, or Kleros Court rules.

listings.name: Kraken
listings.summary: kraken-cli ships kraken-mcp, a local stdio MCP server that exposes 152 CLI commands as tools for MCP clients. The market, paper, and feedback set needs no credentials and cannot trade live or move funds. The trade service places, amends, and cancels live Spot orders. The repository calls the software experimental.

listings.name: L402
listings.summary: HTTP 402 flow that returns a bearer token, recommended as a macaroon, bound to a Lightning invoice by its payment hash. The client pays, then presents the preimage so the server can check payment without a lookup.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Lightning Labs L402 documentation does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Lightning Labs L402 documentation does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Lakera Guard
listings.summary: Guard API at api.lakera.ai. The docs call the product Check Point AI Guardrails. One call screens an agent conversation, including tool definitions, tool calls, and tool results, against a project policy.

listings.name: LangGraph
listings.summary: Low level orchestration runtime for long running stateful agents, with durable execution and human checkpoints inside the graph.

listings.name: Lead Agent Account Numbers
listings.summary: A company provisions a scoped account number for an agent or task through Lead's Account Number API, with per-rail controls.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Agent Account Numbers does not state a fee per payment.
fee_per_payment.source_title: Agent Account Numbers for Agentic Finance

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Agent Account Numbers does not state a minimum payment.
minimum_payment.source_title: Agent Account Numbers for Agentic Finance

sources.title: Agent Account Numbers for Agentic Finance

listings.name: Ledger Agent Intent
listings.summary: Beta approval layer where an agent proposes an Ethereum or Solana send, or an Ethereum swap, and a person approves or rejects it on a Ledger signer. The agent does not hold the wallet keys.

sources.title: How to use Ledger Agent Intent

listings.name: LexisNexis Know Your Agent intelligence
listings.summary: Adds agentic insights to the LexisNexis Risk Solutions identity and fraud platform. It helps organizations recognize AI agents and bring those interactions into risk decisioning. The 5 November 2026 release says many customers already use it. ThreatMetrix and BehavioSec can distinguish humans, bots, and AI agents.

sources.title: LexisNexis Risk Solutions Extends Risk Intelligence to Agentic Activity, 5 November 2026
LexisNexis Risk Solutions Introduces Know Your Agent Intelligence for government agencies, 10 November 2026

listings.name: Lightspark Agent Accounts
listings.summary: A customer's agent gets paid, pays people, and spends from an account the customer owns: a Grid Global Account, a self-custodial Embedded Wallet. Grid checks every agent action against the customer's policy and runs it, refuses it, or holds it for approval. Grid does not run the agent.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-18. A fee per payment. The payments page says a quote includes amounts, fees, and a rate. It does not state a fee amount.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-18. A minimum payment. The payments page and the funding page do not state one.

sources.title: Add Lightspark to your AI app

listings.name: LiteLLM Proxy
listings.summary: Open source proxy that enforces personal, team, and agent spend budgets on model calls when a database is connected. A key on a team uses the team and team member budgets, not the owner's personal budget. Guardrail policy attachments are documented on a page labeled beta.

listings.name: Lumiere PayCheck
listings.summary: Check of an x402 endpoint before payment. Free checks return allow or deny from the monitored price, payout wallet, and uptime. Paid plans add allow, deny, or review with a signed receipt. The payments it watches are on Base and Solana.

listings.name: Machine Payments Protocol
listings.summary: Open HTTP 402 protocol, co-authored by Stripe and Tempo, so an agent can authorize payment for an API with a card or a stablecoin and receive a receipt.

fee_per_payment.text: Stripe's MPP page says Stripe can cover the customer's Tempo network fees when hostedFeePayer is enabled. The page does not state a dollar amount for that network fee or for a card fee.

minimum_payment.text: Stripe's MPP page says the minimum amount for card payments through Shared Payment Tokens is 0.50 USD, and the minimum amount for stablecoin payments is 0.01 USDC.

listings.name: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines
listings.summary: Built on x402. An agent signs a payment voucher after an HTTP 402 challenge, inside a business spending limit. Early Access from 20 October 2026 includes buyer and seller APIs, a toolkit, a sandbox, and documentation. Base settled on-chain and BVNK settled in fiat or stablecoins.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-17. The Early Access page and the 20 October 2026 announcement do not state a fee per payment.
fee_per_payment.source_title: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines Early Access

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-17. The Early Access page and the 20 October 2026 announcement do not state a minimum payment.
minimum_payment.source_title: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines Early Access

Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines at Cloudflare Connect, 2026-10-20

listings.name: Mastra
listings.summary: Open source TypeScript framework for agents and workflows, with memory, tool approvals, and processors that can block or redact content.

listings.name: Mercury MCP
listings.summary: Hosted MCP at https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp. An AI tool can request a payment to an existing recipient or a transfer between Mercury accounts. Requests need approval in Mercury before money moves, and the tool cannot approve them. Approval requests expire after 5 minutes. Category, note, budget, receipt, and reimbursement changes can apply immediately.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Connecting Mercury MCP does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Connecting Mercury MCP does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Mercury support: connecting to ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools

listings.name: MetaMask Agent Wallet
listings.summary: Agent wallet CLI for sending tokens and paying x402 requests. Guard Mode can enforce address and recipient allowlists and a rolling 24 hour outflow limit, and it asks for 2FA outside that policy.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. MetaMask Agent Wallet trading modes does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. MetaMask Agent Wallet trading modes does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
listings.summary: Open framework for orchestrating agents and multi agent workflows in Python and .NET, with graph based workflows, checkpointing, and human in the loop. The overview says the Go SDK is in public preview and requires Go 1.26 or later. The README says the Go SDK lives in microsoft/agent-framework-go.

listings.name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
listings.summary: Identity platform that creates agent identities from blueprints. Microsoft says Agent ID is available to all Entra customers, and that an agent identity has no credentials of its own. The overview says adaptive access policies, real-time risk detection, and audit logs for agents require Microsoft Agent 365.

sources.title: What is Microsoft Entra Agent ID
Overview of agent identities in Microsoft Entra

listings.name: Model Context Protocol
listings.summary: Open protocol that connects LLM applications to external tools, resources, and prompts through a standard request interface.

listings.name: Natural Direct
listings.summary: Generally available as of 29 October 2026. An agent chooses ACH, a domestic wire, or realtime over RTP and FedNow for each payment from the same Natural wallet. A verified business with a funded wallet can use the API, SDKs, CLI, or payments MCP. Checks and international wires are coming soon.

fee_per_payment.text: The Natural Direct page says ACH is 0.5% with a $0.50 minimum and a $1.50 cap, wires are 0.25% with a $15 minimum and a $50 cap, and realtime payments are 1.5% with a $1 minimum.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Natural Direct does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Natural Launches Direct, Bringing ACH, Wire, and Realtime Payments to AI Agents

listings.name: Navoka
listings.summary: An agent with its own stablecoin wallet, IBAN, and card. Wirex Holdings provides the software, and a separate Wirex company provides the accounts.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Navoka Agent Terms does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Navoka Agent Terms does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: NeMo Guardrails
listings.summary: Open source Python library for programmable guardrails that block, alter, or validate user inputs and model responses, and that can inspect tool calls.

listings.name: Nevermined
listings.summary: Payments facilitator that verifies and settles x402 and MPP charges against a payment plan, with metering and delegated card spending.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Nevermined payments facilitator does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Nevermined payments facilitator does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: OKX Agent Trade Kit
listings.summary: OKX Agent Trade Kit connects an AI client to an OKX account with the local okx-trade-mcp server, okx-trade-cli, and agent skills. API keys stay on the machine. The read-only flag limits calls to query tools. The FAQ says a remote MCP deployment is coming.

listings.name: Olas Mech Marketplace
listings.summary: Marketplace where an agent can hire a specialized agent for a task and pay in crypto, or list its own service for other agents to hire. The Mech Marketplace is deployed on 7 chains: Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon and Robinhood.

sources.title: Olas launch note for the Mech Marketplace

listings.name: Open Policy Agent
listings.summary: Open source policy engine. An application sends structured input and OPA returns a decision from Rego policy, separate from the code that enforces it.

listings.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
listings.summary: Library that runs an agent loop in your application. The SDK guide documents tools, handoffs, guardrails, and human review that can pause a run before a sensitive action. OpenAI publishes a Python SDK and a TypeScript SDK.

listings.name: Ornn
listings.summary: Ornn documents hourly Spot or On-demand GPU rental, a node at a time, and a hosted MCP server. ICE and Ornn announced cash settled GPU compute futures on the Ornn Compute Price Index. The 29 September 2026 ICE notice says no listing date is set.

sources.title: Ornn pay as you go guide
ICE and Ornn GPU compute futures announcement

listings.name: Orthogonal
listings.summary: Catalog of paid APIs and tools behind one connection. An agent searches, quotes, and runs calls through the remote MCP at mcp.orthogonal.com, a CLI, or the REST API. Payment is prepaid credits or per call in USDC on Base over x402 or USDC.e on Tempo over MPP, settled before it runs.

listings.name: Pacifica
listings.summary: Pacifica's open source MCP server exposes its perpetual futures REST API as local tools. Those tools cover orders, positions, spot withdrawals, and on-chain funding on Solana. Read only mode needs an account address. An agent key can trade and can be revoked. The server targets testnet by default.

listings.name: PACT
listings.summary: Protocol on A2A 1.0 that lets a personal agent sign its requests and act for a user only inside scopes that user approved with a brand.

listings.name: Pactwright
listings.summary: Soroban escrow for an AI agent purchase on Stellar. The buyer locks a USDC cap in the pact contract until a verifier verdict or signed usage sets the seller amount, and the rest returns to the buyer.

listings.name: PayAI x402 facilitator
listings.summary: x402 facilitator whose Solana batch settlement guide calls facilitator support a public preview. USDC channels use signed vouchers off chain, then claims and distributions on chain. New channel deposits are 0.01 to 100 USDC. The public shared lane needs no account or API key.

fee_per_payment.text: The PayAI site says an account starts with 1,000 free credits, then $1 buys 1,000 credits. Each settled payment costs that network's rate in credits, usually a fraction of a cent. Rates refresh daily, testnets are free, and PayAI does not take a percentage of the payment amount.

minimum_payment.text: The PayAI site says there is no single advertised payment range that applies to every scheme and network. It says a customer price has to satisfy the asset's precision, the advertised requirements, and the selected scheme's rules.

sources.title: PayAI, x402 batch settlement on Solana, 2026-10-22

listings.name: Personal Agent Protocol
listings.summary: Open protocol, version 1.0, for how personal agents and companies work together. It uses OAuth, JWTs, HTTPS, OpenAPI, and MCP where they fit. Access is limited to what was granted and can be revoked. Descope Envoy is a documented implementation.

sources.title: Descope Unveils Envoy, an Identity-Aware Way For Personal AI Agents to Act on People's Behalf

listings.name: Polygon Agent CLI
listings.summary: Agent CLI with an embedded smart wallet. Session mode spends only inside an allowance the owner approves, x402 payments can be capped per call, and session logout revokes that install.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Polygon Agent CLI reference does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Polygon Agent CLI reference does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Prax Labs wallet screening
listings.summary: Wallet screen an agent calls over MCP or REST. screen_wallet returns a risk band, labels such as sanctioned, exploit, phishing, scam, or mixer, and references. The free tier is 10 lookups a day with a work email and no card.

listings.name: preflight402
listings.summary: Free hosted check of an x402 endpoint before payment. It returns proceed, caution, or avoid from liveness, TLS, the 402 handshake, price sanity, uptime, ERC-8004 binding, and Sybil filtered reputation. The guard fails open by default.

listings.name: PrimeXBT MCP
listings.summary: PrimeXBT MCP connects an AI assistant to one PrimeXBT account at https://api.primexbt.com/v2/mcp. No API keys. Claude, ChatGPT in Developer mode, and Claude Code work on PXTrader 2.0, demo or live. Login chooses Read only or Read and trade. No connection can move funds.

sources.title: PrimeXBT MCP: What it is and how to connect

listings.name: px402
listings.summary: Privacy layer for x402 on Base from PRXVT. An agent funds a USDC reserve, withdraws blind signed coins, and a relayer sends plain USDC. The import replaces x402 wrapFetchWithPayment. The non-custodial reserve contract is on Base mainnet. The SDK uses PRXVT hosted issuer, registry, and facilitator services.

fee_per_payment.text: The px402 introduction says px402 charges 1% on each payment, paid on top of the price, and the merchant receives the price. The fee is rounded up to the smallest coin, $0.001, so every payment pays at least $0.001.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. What is px402 does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Pydantic AI
listings.summary: Typed Python agent SDK with structured outputs. The overview says the Pydantic AI Gateway is one key for every model with real-time cost monitoring and budget control. Pydantic AI Harness lists Spend Limits and Guardrails under Control and Safety. Pydantic Graph is a separate open source package.

listings.name: Rain Agent Vaults
listings.summary: A partner embeds an agent vault in its own app. The owner funds it by bank transfer, card, or stablecoins, and the agent pays or sends only what is in it. It pays with a scoped virtual card on Visa or Mastercard. Amount, merchant, and expiry are fixed at issuance.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Agent Vaults product page does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Agent Vaults product page does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Introducing Rain Agent Vaults: Embedded Payments for AI Agents
Rain Agent Vaults bring embedded payments to AI agents, 2026-11-10

listings.name: Render Network
listings.summary: Peer to peer marketplace that matches GPU supply with demand for rendering and machine learning jobs.

listings.name: Robinhood
listings.summary: Robinhood documents a Trading MCP at agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading. Onboarding says the agent can read every Robinhood account and place trades only in the MCP account. Orders can be long equity, options, or crypto. The 27 May 2026 launch called Agentic Trading a beta, and trade approvals are still rolling out.

sources.title: Robinhood guide to onboarding an external agent
Robinhood guide to trading with your agent

listings.name: Sardine Know Your Human (KYH)
listings.summary: Protocol that binds the human behind an agent to checkout. The agent passes Agent-KYH-Provider and Agent-Context-Key, a forwarded IP, and an agent signature. The merchant uses Sardine to read the customer's device fingerprint and IP. Sardine runs it in its Personal Agent and seeks design partners.

sources.title: Know Your Human (KYH) for Agentic Commerce
Sardine launches Know Your Human protocol for agentic commerce, 2026-11-06

listings.name: Scalekit AgentKit
listings.summary: An agent acts in each user's Gmail, Slack, or GitHub as that user. The user approves access once through an authorization link. Scalekit stores and refreshes encrypted OAuth tokens. The agent calls tools by user ID from the Python or Node.js SDK, REST API, or a Virtual MCP server.

listings.name: Schwab MCP Server
listings.summary: Charles Schwab introduces an MCP server that connects a client LLM to Schwab account data. The client can use market data and summarize the portfolio. A thinkorswim enabled account can prepare, place, and manage trades with the client in the loop. The pilot is select clients using Claude.

sources.title: Schwab announces an MCP server, 12 November 2026

listings.name: ServiceNow AI Passport
listings.summary: Cryptographically signed credential an AI agent refers to at runtime to verify its authorized scope. ServiceNow said on 2026-10-15 that AI Passport is expected in Q4 2026. On 2026-10-21 ServiceNow said AI Passport is expected in a future release.

listings.name: Shop MCP
listings.summary: Shopify MCP server and shop CLI. An agent searches Shopify Catalog, builds carts, and checks out with the buyer's Shop Pay. The buyer approves each purchase by default, or sets a weekly, monthly, or total budget. Off Shopify, an approved spend request returns a one time card.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Shop Pay does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Shop Pay does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Using Shop with AI agents and agentic platforms

listings.name: Skyfire
listings.summary: Issues signed KYAPay tokens that bind an agent identity to a payment the buyer has committed, which the seller charges after delivery.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Skyfire KYAPay token documentation does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Skyfire KYAPay token documentation does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: smolagents
listings.summary: Open source Python library whose code agents write actions as code, with an option to run that code in a sandbox.

listings.name: Socure Agent Intelligence
listings.summary: Launched 27 October 2026. Agent Detection is generally available inside Socure Digital Intelligence and returns a confidence score and reason codes. Agent TrustScore is in beta and returns identity, authorization, and risk separately. Agent Credential, a W3C Verifiable Credential, launches in Q1 2027. It runs within Socure RiskOS.

sources.title: Socure Launches Agent Intelligence to Bind Every Agent to the Verified Human Behind It
Introducing Agent Intelligence: Detection, identity, and trust evaluation for AI agents

listings.name: SPACE ID Agent ID
listings.summary: Human readable name for a Binance Agent Wallet on BNB Smart Chain. SPACE ID built it with Binance. Each handle such as alice is minted as a soulbound ERC-721 NFT. Resolve handle to address or address to handle through a public API or the registry contract.

sources.title: Binance Agentic Wallet Agent ID claim status
Agent ID API sample handle alice

listings.name: Stabletrust API
listings.summary: Hosted HTTP API from Fairblock for confidential deposits, transfers, withdrawals, and balance checks. Amounts and balances are encrypted onchain and wallet addresses stay visible. Requests send privateKey and no bearer token. Mainnet is Arbitrum One, Base, and Ethereum, with an ETH protocol fee on transfers and withdrawals.

fee_per_payment.text: The Stabletrust agentic API guide says the wallet pays gas for every operation, and that on mainnet transfers and withdrawals also charge a protocol fee in ETH. It does not state a dollar amount for that fee.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Stabletrust API does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Strands Agents
listings.summary: Open source SDK for a model driven agent loop in Python and TypeScript, with hooks, execution limits, and guardrails around each step.

sources.title: AWS prescriptive guidance for Strands Agents

listings.name: Stripe Issuing for agents
listings.summary: Stripe Issuing cards for agents, including single-use virtual cards. Stripe labels the page Private preview.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Issuing for agents does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Issuing for agents does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Stripe link-cli
listings.summary: CLI for an agent to request a card purchase or a Machine Payments Protocol charge. Link returns a one time payment credential. Since 26 October 2026, a funded Link balance lets the agent skip approval for purchases under a per purchase limit the user sets, first in Instinct.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Enable agents to spend does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Enable agents to spend does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Stripe Treasury for agents
listings.summary: Public preview, announced on 2026-10-21. An agent connects to a Treasury account through Stripe's MCP server at mcp.stripe.com. It can check balances, pay invoices, transfer funds, and convert currencies. Live money movement needs human approval by default. Stripe says agent spending limits and card creation are coming.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Treasury for agents does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Treasury for agents does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Sui Agentic Payments
listings.summary: Testnet gateway where an agent pays per API call in USDC on Sui. The owner sets an onchain grant with allowed services, a total budget, a per payment cap, and an expiry, and can revoke it.

fee_per_payment.text: The Sui Agent Payments page says settlement through MCP is gas sponsored, so the agent's cost is the price of the service, and a $0.001 call stays a $0.001 call. It also says the agent pays in USDC without a separate gas fee.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Sui Agent Payments does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Sunrate Agentic Card
listings.summary: Announced 2 November 2026. Multi-currency virtual commercial card. Agents create cards, set parameters, and initiate transactions. Controls: merchant category, amount, currency, geography, and validity period. Cards can expire after the task. Mastercard Agent Pay certification is complete. Approval policies are described. Who can obtain a card is not stated.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Sunrate Launches Agentic Card to Enable AI-Driven Business Payments does not state a fee per payment.
fee_per_payment.source_title: Sunrate Launches Agentic Card to Enable AI-Driven Business Payments

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Sunrate Launches Agentic Card to Enable AI-Driven Business Payments does not state a minimum payment.

Sunrate Launches Agentic Card to Enable AI-Driven Business Payments, PR Newswire

listings.name: Tempo Wallet
listings.summary: Wallet and CLI that let an agent discover paid services, preview MPP terms, and pay under a max spend cap.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Tempo Wallet agent documentation does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Tempo Wallet agent documentation does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Tempo guide to paying with the CLI

listings.name: TermiX
listings.summary: Marketplace where a buyer funds a job in an escrow contract and the contract pays the provider when the buyer accepts, a timeout passes, or a dispute panel rules.

listings.name: Tradier
listings.summary: Tradier hosts an MCP server on Streamable HTTP for clients such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor. A Tradier API access token authenticates the client. PAPER_TRADING selects the paper or live account. Tools place equity, option, and multileg orders.

listings.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
listings.summary: Open commerce protocol so agents, businesses, and payment providers can negotiate checkout and identity linking over REST, MCP, or A2A.

listings.name: Vangrid
listings.summary: Bounty board where a person or an agent funds a capture in USDC. Funds lock in an on-chain contract until the buyer accepts a submission, or a cancel or a passed deadline returns them.

listings.name: Virtuals Protocol
listings.summary: Agent commerce protocol where agents discover services, negotiate jobs, coordinate execution, and settle payments with each other.

listings.name: Visa Intelligent Commerce
listings.summary: Visa APIs for an agent to act on a consumer authorized purchase instruction. The consumer authenticates, for example with a Visa Payment Passkey, the instruction holds up to 10 mandates with spend parameters, and the agent draws a tokenized Visa credential against a mandate for each purchase.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Visa Intelligent Commerce workflows does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. Visa Intelligent Commerce workflows does not state a minimum payment.

listings.name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
listings.summary: Visa specification for merchants to verify an approved agent from an RFC 9421 HTTP signature bound to the site and action. It reports live European merchant purchases through the protocol and Agent Directory. On 2026-10-20, a live BILL and Billtrust pilot registers BILL's agent with Trusted Agent Protocol.

Visa press release introducing Trusted Agent Protocol (Oct 14, 2025)

Trusted Agent Protocol reference code on GitHub (Visa terms, not an open source license)

listings.name: Walmart Agent Gateway
listings.summary: Walmart's MCP server for agents that shop Walmart and Sam's Club for a customer, in beta for companies and developers. Customers approve agent purchases by default. Agent Profiles, announced 21 October 2026 for the following month, add a per agent spending limit and deletion. Agents never receive card details.

sources.title: Walmart news on agents shopping for customers, 21 October 2026
TechCrunch report on Walmart agent shopping, 21 October 2026

listings.name: Wavelength
listings.summary: A Lightning Labs toolkit gives an app or agent a self-custodial bitcoin wallet. It pays and gets paid over Lightning with no node, channels, or liquidity to manage. Agents drive the wallet over MCP and pay L402 APIs per request. Mainnet opened to everyone on 23 October 2026 as an alpha.

fee_per_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Wavelength system does not state a fee per payment.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The Wavelength system does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Lightning Labs: Wavelength on mainnet, 23 October 2026

listings.name: Web Bot Auth
listings.summary: Method for an automated client to sign HTTP requests so a site can verify which bot or agent sent them. The signature rules are an IETF working group draft, not yet a standard.

sources.title: Google guide to Web Bot Auth
IETF webbotauth working group draft: HTTP Message Signatures for automated traffic

listings.name: WebMCP
listings.summary: Draft Community Group Report dated 9 November 2026. A page registers JavaScript tools on document.modelContext with registerTool(), and those tools run as client side script in the browser session. Agents, browser agents, and assistive technologies can call them. It is not a W3C Standard. Browser support is experimental.

sources.title: WebMCP Draft Community Group Report, 9 November 2026
Cloudflare blog on WebMCP commerce, 21 October 2026

listings.name: x401
listings.summary: Draft HTTP protocol at version 0.2.0. A server sends a PROOF-REQUEST header for a verifiable credential, the agent returns a PROOF-RESPONSE, and payment stays on HTTP 402.

listings.name: x402
listings.summary: Open HTTP payment standard. A server answers with status 402, the client pays and retries, and a facilitator can verify and settle the payment.

fee_per_payment.text: The x402.org page says x402 is free for the customer and the merchant aside from nominal payment network fees. It does not state a dollar amount for those network fees.

minimum_payment.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. x402 site does not state a minimum payment.

sources.title: Coinbase documentation for how x402 works
